description: Land Acquisition - Bibila and Penalaboda, Naula D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for public purposes under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The notice outlines the public purpose (servitude acquisition for the Bowathenna tunnel project) and provides procedural information for interested parties regarding compensation claims. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters.
